searchText: This process is called "Inactivity Leak". You can find more details here: https://eth2book.info/capella/part2/incentives/inactivity/ Do we have any optional field now that we are merging stable container? I want to see how the usage in Python will be, looking into converting the payload as an optional for ePBS. cc <@881905303011086387> in python, it is represented with python's `typing.Optional` Yeah we already have methods that have an optional return. What I don't know if this is all I need to do for the class member in the ssz container regular ssz container cannot have optional fields. only stablecontainer / profile can have optional fields the way how it works is, you make the stablecontainer that defines the merkleization layout. inside that one, every field is optional. then, you make a profile that's specific to prague / whatever fork you want to base ePBS on. inside the profile, you can mix and match required / optional / disallowed fields as you wish example: ```python class Shape(StableContainer[4]): side: Optional[uint16] color: Optional[uint8] radius: Optional[uint16] class Square(Profile[Shape]): side: uint16 color: Optional[uint8] class Circle(Profile[Shape]): color: Optional[uint8] radius: uint16 ``` Ah perfect, thanks, this makes sense in this example, `side` always has `GeneralizedIndex(4)`, `color` is `5`, `radius` is `6` One question is it possible that "attestation inclusion distance" to be 0? no, an attestation for slot `N` can only be processed in slots `M` with `M > N`. So there is no case that is 0? no, in the above example, inclusion distance equals `M-N` Attestation inclusion distance cannot be 0 because that would mean that a block contains attestations for itself. So you would attest for something that contains the attestation itself, which is illogical Thanks <@308223150725005322> , this can vary if 1 indicates that the attestation is included not immediately in the next block but rather in the block following the one the attestation is attesting to. I don't get the "illogical argument" here: if I'm a proposer and for whatever reason I send my block at 8 seconds (perfectly legal and we have such canonical blocks) I would have seen already perfectly valid attestations for my parent. That actually may help my block if we were in a long fork. But we don't allow those attestations anyway I misremembered what inclusion delay means, my bad legal should be "unenforced" in my comment since we're supposed to broadcast at 0

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Do we have any optional field now that we are merging stable container? I want to see how the usage in Python will be, looking into converting the payload as an optional for ePBS. cc <@881905303011086387>

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: in python, it is represented with python's `typing.Optional`

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Yeah we already have methods that have an optional return. What I don't know if this is all I need to do for the class member in the ssz container

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: regular ssz container cannot have optional fields. only stablecontainer / profile can have optional fields

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
the way how it works is, you make the stablecontainer that defines the merkleization layout. inside that one, every field is optional.
then, you make a profile that's specific to prague / whatever fork you want to base ePBS on. inside the profile, you can mix and match required / optional / disallowed fields as you wish

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
example:

```python
    class Shape(StableContainer[4]):
        side: Optional[uint16]
        color: Optional[uint8]
        radius: Optional[uint16]

    class Square(Profile[Shape]):
        side: uint16
        color: Optional[uint8]

    class Circle(Profile[Shape]):
        color: Optional[uint8]
        radius: uint16
```

excerpts.content: Ah perfect, thanks, this makes sense

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: in this example, `side` always has `GeneralizedIndex(4)`, `color` is `5`, `radius` is `6`

excerpts.author: n0price
excerpts.content: So there is no case that is 0?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: no, in the above example, inclusion distance equals `M-N`
